summary_for_children: At-Taghabun teaches us to trust Allah, fear Him as much as we can, listen, obey and spend for good.
environment_concept: A path of steps up a slope, where effort counts (64:16).

areas.name: Path of Effort
areas.anchor_phrase: as much as you are able

activities.name: Do your best
activities.description: Lay six numbered stones in order, one step at a time.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

ayah_environment_connections.anchor_phrase: as much as you are able

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (mountain, steps) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A cottage in a valley and a path climbing over pine hills and a cold pass to a far village

primary_mechanic.text: Pack a bag of 8 spaces from useful things (water skin, bread, cloak, honey for the hosts) and shining ones (gold bangles, silver mirror, carved box), then walk: at each stop (thirst, noon, the cold pass, arriving as a guest) only what you packed helps; otherwise walk back and repack (64:15-16).

secondary_activities: He knows what you hide (64:1, 64:4, read)
unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading by your door, packing, four stops along the walk, then a reading in the far village
world_assets: pine hills and a high pass
environment_behaviour: each stop lights green when its need is met
unique_world.learning_objective: Know that wealth is a test and giving is better for ourselves (64:15-16)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: What Really Matters
story_library.children_narration: Some things seem very important today but may not matter much later. Surah At-Taghabun encourages faith, generosity, patience, and perspective. It reminds us to do our best through life's challenges.

world_idea.title: The Valley of True Treasures
world_idea.description: Children explore a collection of objects and experiences, discovering that kindness and generosity have value beyond possessions.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
